title: 12 Best Multi-Cloud Security Platforms Compared (2026): Features & Pricing
content_md: Quick Answer: Multi-cloud doesn’t just triple your attack surface it triples your billing surface, and vendors price the same workload differently per provider. Wiz and Prisma Cloud sell one-contract parity; Microsoft publishes rates that now extend to AWS/GCP connectors; Fortinet and Check Point bundle into fabric ELAs; Aviatrix bills the network layer everyone else ignores.
